program.name: Short Supersets
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Two supersets a day, upper, lower or full body, in under half an hour.
program.about: Short sessions of paired lifts. Each day is two supersets, two moves back to back with one rest after both: presses and rows on the upper day, squats and hinges on the lower, a mix on the full-body day. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Upper pairs / lower pairs / full-body pairs
